description: This Java class 'ComponentResourceHandler' manages resources for components within the Apache Ofbiz framework. It provides methods for loading, accessing, and representing resource data such as XML documents, URLs, and input streams related to specific components.

classes.name: ComponentResourceHandler
classes.description: Handles loading and managing resources associated with a component, including retrieving XML documents, input streams, URLs, and resource location details.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the loader name associated with this resource handler.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location path of the resource.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads an XML document from the resource stream and returns it as a Document object.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an input stream to the resource content.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL pointing to the resource.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Indicates whether the resource is a file-based resource.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full, resolved location path of the resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another ComponentResourceHandler based on loader name, component name, and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on component name, loader name, and location.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resource handler including component name, loader name, and location.
